tools.description: Use BEFORE paying an unknown x402 endpoint for a job ("token safety check", "web search", "weather forecast", "send USDC", "scrape a page"). Returns the x402 listings that real buyers actually pay for that job, ranked by relevance x distinct payers in the last 30 days x recency x price, with the top

tools.name: seller_benchmark
tools.description: For x402 sellers and builders: rank of each listing by 30-day payers, percentile in its category, price vs the category paid median, metadata gaps (input schema, output example, tags, name, description) compared with the top decile, nearest competitors, a live probe and concrete recommendations. ori

tools.name: market_map
tools.description: Before choosing what to build or how to price it: 20 categories with listings, sellers, 30-day payers and paid calls, estimated gross, leader share, gap score and verdict, the biggest opportunities, price bands, Base vs Solana and the most-paid listings. Optional category (deep dive) and network. No

tools.name: buy_route_pass_week
tools.description: For agents that route many tasks: one x402 payment of $1 returns a pass token that unlocks route_task, seller_benchmark and market_map for 7 days (up to 300 successful calls; route_task lists at $0.02). Then set the MCP client header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["arbiter/pass"]. PAID

tools.name: buy_route_pass_month
tools.description: One x402 payment of $3 returns a pass token that unlocks route_task, seller_benchmark and market_map for 30 days (up to 1,500 successful calls). Then set the MCP client header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["arbiter/pass"]. PAID: $3.00, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base)

tools.name: payment_options
tools.description: FREE. Prices, the receiving address, the x402-over-MCP retry format, and how to use a Route Pass instead (bought once with x402 or with a plain USDC transfer on Base, no x402 client needed).

tools.name: market_peek
tools.description: FREE. Snapshot time, catalog size, how many listings had a paying wallet in 30 days, and the category list, before paying for market_map or route_task.

tools.name: pass_quote
tools.description: FREE, no x402 needed. Returns a quote and the USDC amount to send on Base to this service. After sending, call pass_claim with the quote and the transaction hash to receive the pass token.

tools.name: pass_claim
tools.description: FREE. After the transfer has landed on Base, returns your ap1.… pass (claiming again returns the same pass). Then set the MCP header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["arbiter/pass"].

tools.name: pass_status
tools.description: FREE. Plan, expiry and calls left on the pass sent as the MCP header "Authorization: Bearer ap1..." (or _meta["arbiter/pass"]).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: seller_benchmark · Private data: route_task, buy_route_pass_week, buy_route_pass_month, market_peek, pass_quote · Public sink: route_task, market_map, pass_quote · Destructive: payment_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: seller_benchmark · Private data: route_task, buy_route_pass_week, buy_route_pass_month, market_peek, pass_quote · Public sink: route_task, market_map, pass_quote · Destructive: payment_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
